About This Auction

147± Acres Selling at Auction | Elk County, Kansas | Live Auction August 4 at 1:00 PM at the IGC Sporting Heritage Center 212 N Penn Ave, Independence, KS 67301  Opportunities to purchase quality acreage in Elk County are becoming increasingly difficult to find. This 147± acre property offers a rare combination of recreation, natural beauty, privacy and long-term investment potential. This farm has been appropriately named Oak Ridge Ranch and has some serious upgrades!  Whether you're looking for a weekend escape, a place to make memories with family and friends, a hunting retreat, or simply a piece of Kansas land to call your own, this property checks a lot of boxes. The landscape features a scenic mix of open areas, mature timber, rolling terrain, and a beautiful pond near the center of the property. The pond serves as both a picturesque focal point and a valuable water source for wildlife. Established trails and clearings make it easy to explore and enjoy the property throughout the year. A rock shelf is always the highlight of the tour when visiting this property! Huge boulders that have been pushed up through the earth are begging you to climb on them and overlook the wooded but open bottom. It's the kind of view that makes you stop and enjoy it for a minute.  Wildlife is abundant, with excellent opportunities to observe and pursue whitetail deer, turkey, and other native species. A big established food plot and habitat improvements are already in place, making this a truly turnkey recreational property. Trees that have been removed are strategically placed to make the deer access the plot where they want, making the stands nearby very deadly.  Beyond the recreational opportunities, land ownership continues to be one of the most sought-after investments. Whether your goal is enjoyment, conservation, hunting, or simply owning a piece of the Kansas countryside, this property offers the flexibility to fit a variety of uses. From quiet mornings by the pond to evenings spent watching wildlife from a hilltop, this is the kind of property that creates lasting memories and can be enjoyed for generations. Live Auction August 4 at 1:00 PM at the IGC Sporting Heritage Center 212 N Penn Ave, Independence, KS 67301  Don't miss your chance to bid on this outstanding Elk County property. Contact Andrew Kattenberg with L2 Realty, Inc. for auction information, bidding details, and property tours.
